test: T014 blocker diagnosis: PSI trigger write terminator
finding: kernel psi_write() sets the last byte of the written buffer to NUL; build-hyprland.sh writes b'full 100000 2000000' without a terminator, so the kernel parses window 200000 us (< 500 ms minimum, and not a multiple of 2 s required for unprivileged triggers) and returns EINVAL. Writing with a trailing NUL or newline registers the trigger.
